lumi.name: Mascot Lumi
lumi.description: Native Japanese female voice actress in her early twenties, speaking Japanese, classic anime seiyuu style. Calm, soft, gentle and intelligent, mid pitch, warm and thoughtful delivery. Studio quality recording.

zuzu.name: Mascot Zuzu
zuzu.description: Native Japanese female voice actress in her early twenties, speaking Japanese, classic anime seiyuu style. High-pitched, very energetic, slightly squeaky and highly expressive, bouncy cheerful cartoon energy. Studio quality recording.

anna.name: Mascot Anna
anna.description: Native Japanese female voice actress in her early twenties, speaking Japanese, classic anime seiyuu style. Bright and confident, a bit bossy and smug, proud teasing ojou-sama delivery, clear and assertive. Studio quality recording.

miyu.name: Mascot Miyu
miyu.description: Native Japanese female voice actress in her early twenties, speaking Japanese, classic anime seiyuu style. Quiet, sleepy, breathy, soft and slow, drowsy dreamy delivery, slightly mumbling. Studio quality recording.
